title: 第19章 义父的消息第20章 突破凝元五重
content_zh:
;;
周尘眼神一凝，杀意迸发：“你到底是谁？与义父有何恩怨？”
灰衣男子根本不屑回答，眼中厉色一闪：“小子，你还不配知道！”
话音未落，他周身气势轰然爆发，凝元境七重的强大灵力毫无保留地倾泻而出，如同灰色的浪潮般席卷整个后院。
威压之强，远非之前的林浩等人可比。
“给我束手就擒！”
灰衣男子厉喝一声，身形如电，右手五指成爪，直取周尘肩膀。
“找死！正好拿你来试我新修的拳法！”
周尘不退反进，眼中金芒爆闪！
“天火拳！”
他右拳猛然轰出，没有半点花哨，至阳至刚的纯阳灵力瞬间点燃。
刹那间，周尘的右臂上仿佛有烈焰在燃烧，霸道拳意冲天而起，纯阳本源化作至纯天火，凝聚于拳锋之上。
一拳出，如同陨星坠地，焚尽八荒！
拳爪相交！
咔嚓！
没有惊天动地的爆炸，只有牙骨骼碎裂之声！
“呃啊！”
灰衣男子笑容凝固！他感觉到一股狂暴的炽热之力，瞬间摧毁了他爪上的阴寒灵力，沿着手臂经脉逆冲而上！
他惨叫一声，衣袖瞬间化为飞灰，口中喷出鲜血，。
整个人倒飞出去，狠狠砸在院墙上。

“怎…怎么可能！你…你明明只是凝元三重！怎么会…有这么恐怖的力量？！”
那拳印中蕴含的至阳真意和焚灭之力，让他灵魂都在颤抖！
周尘身形一闪，，一脚便狠狠踩在他的胸膛伤口之上。
他居高临下，脚上微微用力，漠然道：
“现在，可以说了吗？”
“你，到底是谁？”
“找我义父，究竟所为何事？”
灰衣男子胸膛剧痛，口鼻溢血，在周尘巨大的压力下，再无半点反抗的念头，断断续续地说道：
“我…我叫张风！原是天元城一个散修，二十多年前，在外历练时，与…与林义意外结识…”
“我们…我们当时一起发现了一处古老的遗迹在里面，…我们得到了一处大能的传承！传承分两部分，各自选择其一。”
“我…我得到了一部强大的地阶功法，可是那功法品阶太高，深奥无比，我资质有限，参悟二十多年，也未能入门，根本无从修炼！”
说到这里，他一脸愤懑与不甘。
“林义他选择的就是那部《九玄丹经》，后来我在这功法中，这才得知那部《九玄丹经》，它是青州第一丹道大宗天丹门的至高传承！
“九玄丹经的存在，只有天丹门历代门主和数位太上长老知道！”
周尘闻言，心中顿时一惊。
天丹门！
他当然听说过这个名字，这是雄踞青州的庞然大物，其实力和影响力甚至还在天地门之上。
是青州所有炼丹师心目中的圣地，同时也是一个无人敢轻易招惹的恐怖势力！
张风剧烈喘息着，继续说道：
“三个月前…天丹门不知从何处得到消息，《九玄丹经》现世于天阳郡！”

“虽不知具体在什么地方，但门中强者，已经派人在天阳城各大城池调查！”

;;
Zhou Chen's eyes narrowed, and murderous intent burst out: "Who are you? What grudges do you have with your adoptive father?"
The man in gray didn't even bother to answer, and his eyes flashed with a stern expression: "Boy, you don't deserve to know!"
Before he finished speaking, the aura around him exploded, and the powerful spiritual power of the seventh level of the Condensation Realm poured out without reservation, sweeping across the entire backyard like a gray wave.
The coercion was far more powerful than Lin Hao and others before.
"Just let me catch you!"
The man in gray clothes shouted sharply, his figure was like lightning, and the five fingers of his right hand turned into claws, reaching for Zhou Chen's shoulder.
"Looking for death! Just use you to test my new boxing skills!"
Zhou Chen did not retreat but advanced, his eyes flashed with golden light!
"Sky Fire Fist!"
His right fist suddenly punched out, without any fancy, the pure Yang spiritual power of Zhiyang Zhigang was instantly ignited.
In an instant, Zhou Chen's right arm seemed to be burning with flames, his domineering fist intention soared into the sky, and the pure Yang source turned into pure heavenly fire, condensing on the fist edge.
With one punch, it was like a meteor falling to the ground, burning all the wasteland!
Fists and claws intertwined!
Click!
There was no earth-shattering explosion, just the sound of shattering teeth and bones!
"Uh-huh!"
The man in gray’s smile froze! He felt a violent fiery force that instantly destroyed the cold spiritual power on his claws and rushed up along the meridians of his arms!
He screamed, his sleeves instantly turned into ash, and blood spurted out of his mouth.
The whole person flew out and hit the courtyard wall hard.
"How...how is it possible! You...you are obviously only at the third level of Yuan Condensation! How could you...have such terrifying power?!"
The true meaning of the Sun and the power of burning contained in that fist seal made his soul tremble!
Zhou Chen's figure flashed, and he stepped hard on the wound on his chest.
He was condescending, exerted slight pressure on his feet, and said indifferently:
"Now, can you say it?"
"Who are you?"
"Why are you looking for my adoptive father?"
The man in gray clothes suffered from severe pain in his chest and bleeding from his mouth and nose. Under Zhou Chen's huge pressure, he no longer had the slightest idea of resistance and said intermittently:
"I...my name is Zhang Feng! I was originally a casual cultivator in Tianyuan City. More than 20 years ago, when I was training outside, I accidentally met... and Lin Yi..."
"We...we discovered an ancient ruins inside together,...we got a powerful inheritance! The inheritance is divided into two parts, each choose one."
"I...I have obtained a powerful earth-level technique, but that technique is too high-grade and extremely profound. I have limited qualifications and have been studying it for more than 20 years, but I have not been able to get started. There is no way to practice it!"
Speaking of this, he looked angry and unwilling.
"Lin Yi chose the "Nine Mysterious Alchemy Sutra". Later, during this practice, I learned about the "Nine Mysterious Alchemy Sutra". It is the supreme inheritance of the Tiandan Sect, the number one alchemy sect in Qingzhou!
“Only the successive sect leaders of the Tiandan Sect and several supreme elders know about the existence of the Nine Mysterious Alchemy Sutra! "
Zhou Chen was shocked when he heard this.
Tiandanmen!
Of course he has heard of this name. This is a behemoth that dominates Qingzhou, and its strength and influence are even above the gate of heaven and earth.
It is the holy land in the hearts of all alchemists in Qingzhou, and it is also a terrifying force that no one dares to easily provoke!
Zhang Feng gasped violently and continued:
"Three months ago... the Tiandan Sect received news from somewhere that the "Nine Mysterious Alchemy Sutra" appeared in Tianyang County! "
“Although I don’t know where exactly it is, the strong men in the sect have sent people to investigate in all the major cities in Tianyang City! "
